Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 2019
ORDINANCE V OF 2019
ASSETS DECLARATION (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2019
An Ordinance to amend the Assets
Declaration Act, 2019
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
1st July, 2019]
No.
F.2(1)/2019-Pub., dated 1.7.2019.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President on 1st July, 2019 is hereby
published for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Assets Declaration Act, 2019 for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
AND
WHEREAS the Senate and the National Assembly are not in session and the
President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is satisfied that circumstances
exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
NOW,
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President of Islamic
Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance shall be called the Assets Declaration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
